sentences.en: This product is well known by its advertisement on television.
sentences.zh: 这个产品因为电视广告而广为人知。

sentences.en: Read the advertisement section if you're looking for a job.
sentences.zh: 如果你想找工作，可以看看招聘广告。

sentences.en: The price shown in this advertisement only includes the frame.
sentences.zh: 这份广告里标示的价格只包括镜框。

senses.zh: 广告, 广告宣传, 启事, 广告（样）品
